snippet.title: Bardy's Maze: The World's First Zard-PG!! - The DeFUNitive Edition! [RELEASE TRAILER]
snippet.description:
Bardy's Maze: The World's First Zard-PG! The DeFUNitive Edition is finally here, so pick up your mics and start beatboxing!
Download the game here!
https://jasontgf.itch.io/bardysmaze
Follow the brand new official Not Real Inc twitter account for updates on all things Bardy!
https://twitter.com/REALnotrealinc
And don't forget to like and subscribe to the new YouTube channel as well!
https://www.youtube.com/@NotRealInc

Bardy's Maze: The World's First Zard-PG is a fangame based on Zardy's Maze, by famed internet celebrity Swankybox. The game was created for the Zardy's Maze Game Jam. This new update adds loads of extra polish and new features! As Not Real Inc's first public release, we hope you'll enjoy it!
Created by: JasonTGF, smileyshirt and Dairy Product
